comment: Curated registry of known-good external agents the one-shot-prompting plugin can discover and route work to. Entries are READ-ONLY pointers; the curator skill adds new entries with user approval.

agents.description: Reviews code for adherence to project guidelines, style guides, best practices. Use proactively after writing or modifying code, before commit. Reads CLAUDE.md and project conventions; outputs findings list.
Hunts silent failures, inadequate error handling, and inappropriate fallback behavior in code changes. Use after writing try/catch or fallback logic.
Analyzes type design — encapsulation, invariant expression, usefulness, enforcement. Use when introducing new types or during PR review.
Analyzes code comments for accuracy, completeness, and long-term maintainability. Catches comment rot, incorrect statements, missing why-this-matters notes.
Reviews PRs for test coverage quality and completeness. Use after a PR is created/updated to ensure tests adequately cover new functionality and edge cases.
agents.notes: May replace our critic agent for PR-style test review. Critic runs pytest; this analyzes COVERAGE of the tests themselves.

agents.description: Simplifies code for clarity and maintainability while preserving functionality. Use after the implementer produces working code that could be more idiomatic.
agents.notes: Optional post-implementer pass for non-time-critical generations.

agents.description: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use to find files by pattern, grep for symbols, or answer 'where is X defined / which files reference Y.'
agents.notes: Use for ad-hoc 'where does this live?' questions. Our codebase_graph is for systematic pre-generation scans.

agents.description: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, considers architectural trade-offs.
agents.notes: Native Claude Code planning agent. Lighter weight than our architect for pre-spec scoping conversations.
